description: Finds the pages, FAQ answers, use cases, articles and shop products of printags.com that answer a question, with the shop's current unit prices excluding VAT. Use it for what Printags sells, how ordering works, which chips exist, prices, or how to use the API and the MCP servers.

locale.description: Language of the answers. Defaults to the language of the question.

query.description: The question or keywords, in English or French.
